title: Five Fingers Of Funk's "My Mom's Prius": A Funky Ode to the Humble Hybrid
htmlContent:
Five Fingers Of Funk is back with a bang, and their latest release, "My Mom's Prius," proves their unwavering commitment to creating groovy, funk-infused hip hop. The song is an ode to the humble hybrid car, with DJ Chillest Illest spinning turntable magic over a thumping bassline and a brass section that adds an irresistible swing.

"My Mom's Prius" is a testament to Five Fingers Of Funk's ability to create fun and socially conscious music, celebrating sustainability and responsible consumption with a healthy dose of humor and style. The lyrics are witty and playful, with the MC rapping about the joys of cruising in his mom's eco-friendly ride. The chorus is catchy and infectious, and it's easy to imagine crowds bouncing to the beat and singing along.

The song is part of their latest album, "Portland Say It Again," which marks the band's first release with the original lineup since 1998. With guest appearances from Cool Nutz, Jumbo (of the Lifesavas), Bosko, and Dres from Black Sheep, the album is a testament to Five Fingers Of Funk's enduring influence on Portland's music scene and their commitment to keeping the funk alive.
